meta.name: schema-markup-generator
meta.description: Generate JSON-LD structured data markup for rich results in Google Search. Supports FAQ, HowTo, Article, Product, LocalBusiness, and multi-type schemas. Validates against Google requirements and provides implementation guidance. Use when asked to "add schema markup", "generate structured data", "JSON-LD", "rich snippets", "FAQ schema", "product markup", "add structured data to my page", "how to get rich snippets", or any structured data task.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为网页生成结构化数据标记，提升搜索引擎展示效果
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在Google搜索中展示更丰富的页面信息
copy.tagline_en: Generate structured data markup for better search engine display
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to display richer page information in Google search results

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能根据你的内容生成 JSON-LD 格式的结构化数据标记，帮助网页在谷歌搜索中获得富媒体摘要。它支持常见类型如 FAQ、产品、文章等，并验证标记是否符合谷歌要求。
howto.when: 当你要求添加结构化数据、生成 JSON-LD、或提到“FAQ schema”、“product markup”等关键词时触发。

say.text: 为这个 FAQ 页面生成 schema 标记。
为我的产品页创建 Product schema。
say.note: Claude 会生成包含价格、库存等属性的标记。

say.text: 检查并改进这段 schema 标记。
say.note: Claude 会验证并优化现有标记。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can generate JSON-LD structured data markup based on your content to help web pages get rich results in Google Search. It supports common types like FAQ, Product, Article, etc., and validates the markup against Google requirements.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to add structured data, generate JSON-LD, or mention keywords like 'FAQ schema', 'product markup', etc.

say_en.text: Generate schema markup for this FAQ page.
Create Product schema for my product page.
say_en.note: Claude will generate markup with price, availability, etc.

say_en.text: Review and improve this schema markup.
say_en.note: Claude will validate and optimize existing markup.
